name: Odette
description: Women’s fashion and accessories sold online and through retail stores, with a proposed company-operated franchise format.
about: Odette brings clothing and accessories together in a women's fashion store, with dresses, co-ord sets, Indian wear, bags, footwear and jewellery in its range. Its design approach combines French influences with Indian craftsmanship, giving shoppers a mix of everyday outfits and occasion pieces. Customers can shop online or visit its physical stores across India. For franchise partners, the published company-operated format covers day-to-day store execution, merchandising and brand standards, with support for opening, training and marketing.

facts.shortDescription: Premium women’s fashion and accessories brand offering modern apparel, handbags, footwear, perfumes, and lifestyle collections through omnichannel retail stores across India.
facts.brandAbout: Odette is a fast-growing Indian women’s fashion brand co-founded in 2020, built as a one-stop destination for western wear, ethnic apparel, handbags, footwear, jewellery, perfumes, and lifestyle accessories. The label focuses on trend-led, everyday styles—from dresses and co-ord sets to bags and skin essentials—at accessible price points for modern shoppers. With 50+ stores across malls and high streets in Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities, Odette serves markets including Karnataka, Delhi NCR, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, and other key states. Rooted in a Victorian-inspired design sensibility, the brand helps women build complete wardrobes with pieces that feel current, comfortable, and effortlessly wearable. Odette continues to expand nationally, strengthening its reputation as a scalable omnichannel fashion retail brand.
facts.returns: Minimum Guarantee ₹1.25 Lakhs per month or 12% Revenue Share (whichever is higher)

name: Original Burger Co
description: A burger restaurant concept centred on smash burgers, hand-pressed patties and a menu of sides and drinks.
about: Original Burger Co centres its menu on smash burgers, using patties pressed onto the cooking surface to develop a caramelised crust. The brand describes a hands-on preparation style, with hand-pressed patties, toasted buns and sauces made in-house. Its burger-led offering is accompanied by sides and drinks in a casual restaurant setting. Part of Beamer Brands, the business has roots in Bengaluru, and its official website also lists Chennai and Hyderabad among its Indian locations.

facts.shortDescription: Gourmet burger QSR brand focused on premium burgers, loaded sides, shakes, and fast casual dining experiences designed for urban food lovers.
facts.returns: FICO (8% on Net Sales or 15% as minimum guarantee on total investment, whichever is higher)
facts.mcp: Bengaluru (15), Chennai (15), Hyderabad (12), Kolkata (10), Mumbai (10), Pune (10), Delhi NCR (15) — FICO. Gujarat (8), Kerala (8), Rajasthan (6), Coimbatore & Ooty (3), Indore & Bhopal (3), North-East (6), Goa (6), Punjab (4) — FOFO

name: Franco
description: A Bengaluru-based men’s fashion label offering shirts, T-shirts, sweatshirts, trousers, jackets and shorts.
about: Franco is a Bengaluru-based menswear label with a wardrobe built around shirts, T-shirts, sweatshirts, jackets, trousers and shorts. Its collection mixes printed cotton-jersey pieces with solid trousers and outerwear, offering options for relaxed dressing and more put-together everyday looks. The range gives shoppers room to build outfits around colour, print and layering. An online shop presents new arrivals alongside best sellers, while a dedicated menswear retail setting lets customers explore that contemporary clothing selection in person.

facts.shortDescription: Contemporary men’s fashion brand delivering trend-driven apparel, casual wear, and premium lifestyle fashion for modern urban consumers.
facts.returns: Minimum Guarantee ₹1.25 Lakhs or 12% of Sale whichever is higher
facts.targetAreas: Bangalore, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Chennai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Lucknow, Surat, Indore and other metro cities

name: Biggies Burger
description: An Indian grilled-burger brand with vegetarian, chicken and lamb options, alongside wraps, fries, shakes and desserts.
about: Biggies Burger is an Indian burger brand that puts grilled patties at the centre of its menu. Chicken and lamb burgers sit alongside vegetarian choices, with flavours such as tandoori, peri-peri and makhani bringing variety to the range. The menu also extends to grilled wings, wraps, fries, shakes and desserts, giving customers options beyond a single burger. Founded in 2011, the brand began franchising in 2016 and has developed a restaurant network around this burger-led format.

facts.shortDescription: One of India’s leading homegrown burger QSR chains known for grilled burgers, wings, shakes, combo meals, and youth-focused dining experiences.
facts.targetAreas: Pan India Presence across 17+ States & 37+ Cities

name: Bigguys
description: A quick-service chicken concept featuring flavoured and Korean-style fried chicken, grilled options and burgers.
about: Bigguys is a chicken-led restaurant brand from Beamer Brands, with a focus on flavoured fried chicken and Korean-style options. Its featured range also includes grilled chicken legs, burgers and chicken-tender salad, giving customers several ways to order beyond a bucket of chicken. The brand developed from a delivery-focused operation into dine-in restaurants. Its official store directory includes Bengaluru, Chennai and Hyderabad, alongside locations in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh, reflecting a footprint across several Indian markets.

facts.shortDescription: Homegrown fried chicken QSR brand blending Korean-style crispiness with bold Indian-inspired flavors, built for delivery and dine-in scale.
facts.targetAreas: Tier 1, Tier 2 & Tier 3 Cities Across India

name: Brand Avenue
description: A multibrand factory-outlet concept offering value-priced apparel and footwear for men, women and children.
about: Brand Avenue is a Bengaluru-based chain of multibrand factory outlets offering apparel and footwear for men, women and children. Its stores bring casual clothing, formalwear and sportswear together, with a focus on shoppers looking for recognisable brands at accessible prices. The business is part of Wular Lifestyle Private Limited and combines value retail with a modern store setting. Its published partnership offer includes both franchisee-operated and company-operated formats, allowing the operating approach to be discussed alongside the location and store plan.

facts.shortDescription: Multi-brand fashion (MBO) retail store offering branded apparel and lifestyle products across India.
facts.returns:
FICO min 18% per annum
Revenue - 7 % 
FOFO 25 % margin

name: Lassi N Cafe
description: A cafe concept combining lassi and other drinks with burgers, sandwiches, pizza and snacks.
about: Lassi N Cafe brings together familiar Indian drinks and a broad cafe menu. Sweet, mango and dry fruit lassis sit alongside thick shakes and mojitos, while burgers, sandwiches, pizzas and fried chicken turn a drink stop into a meal. The range includes vegetarian and chicken choices, giving groups several ways to order together. With outlets in Karnataka and a franchise programme that includes setup and marketing support, the brand combines its lassi identity with the variety of a neighbourhood quick-service cafe.

facts.shortDescription: Youth-focused café and QSR brand serving lassis, shakes, burgers, wraps, desserts, waffles, and café-style quick bites.
facts.locationType: High Street / Youth Hangout / Delivery-Based Market

name: Fusion Pizza & Big Burger Co
tagline: Pizza and burgers under one concept
description: A paired pizza-and-burger concept serving customers through restaurant, delivery and pickup channels.
about: Fusion Pizza & Big Burger Co pairs two familiar quick-service favourites in a single concept. Fusion Pizza brings the pizza side of the offer, while Big Burger Co adds a burger brand developed from the same business. Customers can use the combined app to choose delivery or pickup and customise their orders with available add-ons. Big Burger Co also connects customers to Swiggy and Zomato, giving the paired brands several ordering channels around a straightforward pizza-and-burger proposition.

facts.shortDescription: Dual-brand QSR concept combining pizzas, burgers, wraps, beverages, desserts, and fast-food favorites under a scalable dine-in and delivery model.
facts.locationType: High Street / Food Court / Delivery Market
facts.returns: Avg Monthly Sales ₹7 to 13 Lakhs, Net Profit 23 to 25%

name: Kasturi Creations
description: An Indian ethnic wear label offering kurta sets, sarees, dresses and co-ords, with online and physical retail.
about: Kasturi Creations is a women's ethnic wear label launched in 2013 under Style Saga. Its collection moves from kurta and dupatta sets to sarees, dresses and co-ords, with ranges built around Indian weaving and printing traditions such as Jamdani, Ikkat and Ajrakh. Customers can explore everyday and occasion wear online or in the brand's showrooms. A fashion studio offering bespoke styling and stitching adds a personal element, helping shoppers adapt a look to their preferences and the occasion.

facts.shortDescription: Women’s Indian ethnic wear brand offering sarees, kurtas, fusion collections, and occasion wear through retail stores in malls and high streets across India.
facts.returns: Minimum Guarantee ₹1,75,000 per month or 10% revenue share (whichever is higher)

name: 10 Downing Street
description: An English-style pub concept combining food, drinks, music and themed social evenings.
about: 10 Downing Street brings an English pub atmosphere to Indian cities, combining dining and drinks with a lively calendar of music and themed evenings. The brand began in Hyderabad and developed a recognisable social setting centred on interiors, hospitality and time spent with friends. Its published programme includes karaoke, retro music, rock and Bollywood nights. That mix gives 10D a broad hospitality identity, from an informal meal to an evening out, with a consistent pub concept across its network.

facts.shortDescription: British-inspired pub and nightlife chain offering premium dining, cocktails, music, brewery experiences, and social entertainment spaces.
facts.locationType: Tier II Cities / Metro Cities / Brew House Locations
facts.franchiseFee: Classic - 35L + GST, Premium(Metro) -50L + GST , Brew House - 75L + GST

name: Freshco Goli Soda
description: A beverage business centred on marble-sealed goli soda bottles, with a proposed manufacturing and local distribution model.
about: Freshco Goli Soda builds its beverage range around the familiar marble-sealed soda bottle. Its line-up moves from lemon and jeera to fruit-led options such as green mango, red guava and blueberry, bringing variety to a drink associated with Indian street-side refreshment. The franchise proposition centres on producing and distributing beverages locally. Freshco describes support for machinery, raw materials, staff training and marketing, connecting the product's nostalgic appeal with a manufacturing business that supplies shops and other local sales channels.

facts.shortDescription: India’s fastest-growing beverage manufacturing franchise — from heritage Goli Soda roots to 207+ factories, 100+ patented flavours, and 10+ products with pan-India and international scale.
facts.locationType: Manufacturing unit with water, power & local supply logistics
facts.returns: Avg monthly profit ₹3 Lakhs after all expenses

name: EMORI
description: A lab-grown diamond jewellery brand with online shopping and experience stores, offering everyday, gifting and occasion designs.
about: EMORI specialises in lab-grown diamond jewellery, with designs for everyday wear, gifting and milestone occasions. Its collection includes rings, earrings, pendants, necklaces, bracelets and mangalsutras, with gold options such as 14KT and 18KT. The brand pairs its online store with physical locations in Gurugram, Noida and Dwarka, where customers can explore pieces in person. Certified diamonds, hallmarked gold and customisation are central to the offer, giving shoppers several ways to find jewellery that fits their style and budget.

facts.shortDescription: Lab-grown diamond jewellery brand offering a premium retail experience through high-street and mall stores under a structured FICO franchise model.
facts.brandAbout: Founded in September 2023 and headquartered in Gurugram, EMORI started as an online-first D2C brand. EMORI offers lab-grown diamond jewellery in 14 and 18 karat gold for the modern consumer, balancing design, accessibility, and everyday wearability. After establishing a strong online presence, EMORI expanded into high-traction offline markets through strategically located stores. Its omnichannel approach has strengthened brand trust and visibility, with three physical stores consistently delivering strong performance and curated in-store experiences alongside growing consumer demand. Following its appearance on Shark Tank India, EMORI secured ₹3 crore in funding from four sharks: Anupam Mittal, Ritesh Agarwal, Namita Thapar, and Amit Jain. EMORI is targeting franchise expansion across Bengaluru (Bangalore), Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Delhi, Noida, Jaipur, Chandigarh, and Gurugram (Gurgaon).
